highlight: Boarding Air India AI-356 non-stop to Tokyo Haneda
content: Started the journey at Bengaluru T2 on AI-2852 to Mumbai T2. Having both flights in BOM Terminal 2 made the layover effortless before boarding AI-356 non-stop to Haneda.

placeHeading: Tokyo — Asakusa, Ueno Ginkgos, Imperial Palace & Skytree Sunset
highlight: Watching the 16:33 sunset paint Mt. Fuji from Tokyo Skytree
content: Landed at Haneda T3 at 04:55 AM, rode the direct train to Higashi-Nihombashi, and dropped bags at APA Bakurocho. Explored Senso-ji in early morning light, Ueno Park's golden ginkgos, Imperial Palace East Gardens, and caught the 16:00 sunset slot at Tokyo Skytree.

placeHeading: Kamakura & Enoshima — Direct JR Coastal Day Trip
highlight: Enoden coastal tram & 16:32 Pacific sunset at Enoshima
content: Boarded the direct JR Sobu-Yokosuka Rapid right outside JR Bakurocho Station (zero transfers to Kita-Kamakura!). Explored Engaku-ji's red maples, the Great Bronze Buddha at Kotoku-in, and watched sunset over the sea at Enoshima.

placeHeading: West Tokyo — Meiji Jingu Gaien, Harajuku, Tokyo Toilet Trail & Shibuya SKY
highlight: 15:40 Shibuya SKY sunset slot & Shigeru Ban transparent glass toilets
content: Started at 06:45 AM under the golden ginkgo tunnel of Meiji Jingu Gaien, wandered Shinjuku Gyoen's Maple Mountain, walked the architectural Tokyo Toilet trail from Harajuku into Shibuya, and reached Shibuya SKY at 15:20 for the 15:40 sunset slot.

placeHeading: Fujikawaguchiko — Fuji Excursion 93, Chureito Pagoda & Maple Corridor
highlight: Chureito Pagoda framing snow-capped Mt. Fuji & Momiji Kairo night light-up
content: Rode Car 3 (Seats 6A & 6B) on Fuji Excursion 93 from Shinjuku Platform 9 straight to Kawaguchiko. Climbed to Chureito Pagoda in afternoon sun, checked into Seminar Plaza Royal Fuji at 16:00, and walked the illuminated Maple Corridor.

placeHeading: Lake Kawaguchiko ➔ Kyoto — Hikari 713, Gion Corner & Kodai-ji Illumination
highlight: Mirror Mt. Fuji at 06:25 sunrise & 18:00 Maiko performance at Gion Corner
content: Caught the sunrise reflection on Lake Kawaguchiko, took the 10:20 Bus 0108-1 to Mishima North, and rode Hikari 713 (Car 14, Seats 16D/16E) into Kyoto. Checked into Le Lion d'Or at 16:05, watched the 18:00 show at Gion Corner, and visited Kodai-ji's night illumination.

placeHeading: Kyoto — Hokan-ji Sunrise, Kiyomizu-dera, Nijo Castle, Philosopher's Path & Eikan-do
highlight: Empty 06:15 AM Sannenzaka cobblestones & Eikan-do's 3,000 illuminated maples
content: Watched sunrise at Hokan-ji Pagoda and Kiyomizu-dera before crowds arrived, toured Nijo Castle at 08:45 opening, dropped bags at Rinn Gion Shinbashi, ate through Nishiki Market, walked Philosopher's Path from Ginkaku-ji to Nanzen-ji, and ended at Eikan-do's night illumination.

placeHeading: Kyoto — Fushimi Inari Sunrise, Tofuku-ji, Kinkaku-ji & Arashiyama
highlight: Tsutenkyo Bridge at Tofuku-ji at 08:30 AM & Golden Pavilion in midday sun
content: Hiked Fushimi Inari at 06:15 sunrise, stood over Tofuku-ji's sea of red maples at 08:30, dropped bags at Hotel SUI Kyoto Kiyomizu, picked up our JR-West Kansai-Hiroshima Pass at Kyoto Station, and visited Kinkaku-ji and Arashiyama.

placeHeading: Kyoto Northern Mountains — Kurama Temple, Kifune Lantern Stairs & Momiji Tunnel
highlight: Kifune Shrine lantern-lit stairs at dusk & Eizan train lights-off Momiji Tunnel!
content: Rode the Eizan train up to Kurama Temple, crossed to Kifune Shrine for the water fortune slip and watched the vermilion lanterns light up along the stone stairs at 16:47 sunset, then rode the Eizan train back through the glowing Momiji Tunnel!

placeHeading: Nara & Osaka — Nara Deer Park, Todai-ji & Dotonbori Neon Night
highlight: Bowing deer under autumn leaves in Nara & Takoyaki in Dotonbori
content: Used our JR Pass on the Miyakoji Rapid to Nara, stored bags in JR Nara lockers, fed the deer and marvelled at Todai-ji, then rode the Yamatoji Rapid + Midosuji Line to check into APA Hommachi Tower at 15:12 before Dotonbori.

placeHeading: Hiroshima & Miyajima — Mizuho 601, Floating Torii, Peace Park & Nozomi 36
highlight: 08:20 AM crowd-free Miyajima Floating Torii & Momijidani Maple Valley
content: Boarded Mizuho 601 at 06:00 AM (Car 4, Seats 7A/7B), caught the 08:10 JR Ferry to Miyajima Island, explored Itsukushima Shrine and Momijidani Park, visited the Atomic Bomb Dome & Peace Museum, and rode Nozomi 36 (15:00 -> 16:43) back to Osaka.

placeHeading: Okayama & Osaka Castle — Korakuen Garden, Crow Castle & Golden Hour Keep
highlight: Okayama Korakuen at 08:00 AM opening & reaching Osaka Castle by 13:30!
content: Took Mizuho 601 (06:00–06:50, Car 5, Seats 7D/8D), entered Korakuen Garden at 08:00 AM and Okayama Castle at 09:45, rode Sakura 746 (12:14–12:59, Seats 9D/11D) back to Shin-Osaka, and reached Osaka Castle at 13:30 for afternoon sun and golden hour.

placeHeading: Osaka ➔ Tokyo — Nozomi 18, Tokyo Tower Sunset & teamLab Borderless (17:30)
highlight: Daytime Mt. Fuji view from Nozomi 18 Seat 7E/8E & teamLab Borderless at 17:30
content: Rode Nozomi 18 (12:06–14:33, Car 3, Seats 7E/8E) back to Tokyo, checked into Hotel Livemax Ningyocho at 15:05, watched the 16:28 sunset behind Zojo-ji and Tokyo Tower, and walked 11 mins to Azabudai Hills for our 17:30 teamLab Borderless immersion.

placeHeading: Tokyo — Tsukiji Outer Market, Rikugien Maple Garden & Ginza Shopping
highlight: Peak late-November maple reflections in Rikugien Pond
content: Breakfast at Tsukiji Outer Market, morning sunlight photography at Rikugien Gardens (09:00 opening), and final tax-free shopping in Ginza before packing our suitcases at Ningyocho.

placeHeading: Tokyo Haneda ➔ Delhi (DEL T3) ➔ Bengaluru — Journey Home
highlight: Direct 40-min train from Ningyocho to Haneda T3 & smooth DEL T3 self-transfer
content: Used the Exit A6 elevator 49m from Hotel Livemax to board the 07:55 direct Airport Express to Haneda T3. Flew AI-357 (11:45–18:20) to Delhi T3, completed our 3h 10m self-transfer, and landed back at Bengaluru T2 at 00:25 AM on Dec 1!
